title: C15 annex1-variant variant
description: Catalog row c15-outputs 2.0.0: one SDD variant of the IRRBB case on a CLP and UF balance sheet under RAN 21-13 Annex 1 (outputs.kind annex1-variant).

c15Label.description: A non-empty bilingual label (an empty string is not a label).

c15Sign.description: Sign convention, stated in the document: a positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss (SRP31.129; dossier 01 H.4).

c15Units.description: Units of every number: money in the stated scale of its currency, rates as decimals discounted continuously (SRP31.129), shocks in basis points, bucket midpoints in years, dates ISO.

c15Assumption.description: A behavioural assumption as a named field: its value, its unit and where it comes from (the regulatory cap, a fit, or a stated synthetic value), so a view can show the result with and without it.

c15Assumptions.description: The five behavioural assumptions. nmd_core_share and nmd_core_maturity_years are the balance-weighted averages of nmd_segments.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

amount.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15Flow.description: A net notional repricing cash flow in one bucket (assets positive, liabilities negative).

balance.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

requested_core_share.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

core_share_cap.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

core_share_used.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c15NmdSegment.description: A non-maturity deposit segment: the requested core share and maturity, the SRP31 Table 4 cap, the value used and cap_applied (D2 of the U10 sizing). A request above its cap validates only with cap_applied true and the used value at the cap; a request within the caps has cap_applied false and the used value equal to the request (a producer check). The standardised EVE uses the used values.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c15ShockSize.description: The shock sizes applied to a currency, in basis points. A tabled size is exactly the table's (SRP31.90 Table 2, d368 Annex 2 Table 1, RAN 21-13 Annex 1 Hoja 9); a currency without an entry in the BCBS table (CLP is in neither) passes only labelled as a Contraste estimate with its method, never as a regulatory parameter (dossier 01 H.3), and a tabled currency cannot be relabelled as an estimate.

c15DynItem.description: One item of the dynamic NII projection (the inputs of simulate_nii): a reset rate is spread + beta x r_t; reprice_months 0 reprices every month, k >= 1 keeps rate0 until month k and resets every k months.

short_rate_path.description: Annual short rate of each projected month, after the floor.

monthly_nii.description: NII of each projected month, money.

total.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_vs_base.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15DynScenario.description: The projected NII under the base path or one parallel shock; delta_vs_base = base total minus this total (loss-positive).

c15DynScenarios.description: base, parallel-up, parallel-down, in that order.

c15BsAssumption.description: The balance-sheet assumption of the projection: a constant balance sheet (maturing or repricing flows replaced by identical new ones, DIS70.5) or an annual growth.

c15Bank.description: The synthetic Banco Andino, calibrated to CMF aggregates (U5's calibration); fixtures say so.

c15Ur.description: The UR currency of RAN 21-13 Annex 1: all CLP-indexed flows are treated as one currency (CLF, UF-indexed). UF amounts are CLF; uf_value is the CLP value of one UF on uf_date.

c15Variant.description: The SDD variant of the case (section 5): one document per variant.

c15Point.description: One tenor: the observed BCCh yield and the fitted continuously compounded zero rate.

zero_rates_at_midpoints.description: Zero rate at each bucket midpoint, bucket 1 first.

c15Curve.description: A BCCh F022 sovereign curve (CLP or UF) of the stated month, fitted to a zero curve and labelled as an adaptation: the attribution names the Banco Central de Chile as the owner of the source and the fit as Contraste's (BCCh terms, dossier 08 C.7). A currency with fewer than four published secondary-market tenors (the engine's Nelson-Siegel fit needs four points) takes the Banco Central's monetary policy rate (F022.TPM.TIN.D001.NO.Z.D, the overnight rate) as an extra point at 1/360 year; it is a policy rate and not a yield, it is listed in series_codes, and the source says so. Only the CLP curve has such an anchor.

c15Item.description: One synthetic Banco Andino item in the currency of its leg, slotted into the buckets (the Annex 1 NMD caps applied).

assets_total.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

liabilities_total.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

net_position.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15Leg.description: One leg of the banking book in the currency of the leg (CLF for the UR leg): net_position = assets minus liabilities. The CLP leg is in CLP and the UR leg is in CLF.

c15NiiSize.description: The delta NII shock of Annex 1 Hoja 9: one parallel size, 300 bp for CLP and CLF.

shape_bp.description: Shock in basis points at each bucket midpoint before the floor.

items.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).
Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

net_cash_flows.description: One value per bucket, bucket 1 first; net notional repricing cash flows, assets positive, liabilities negative.

eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

kao.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15LegEve.description: One leg under one shock, in the reporting currency (the UR leg converted at the UF value).

delta_clp.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_ur.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

with_offset.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

without_offset.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

used.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15Pair.description: The CLP and CLF pair. with_offset applies the 50 percent offsetting rule when the two have opposite signs; without_offset is the sum of the positive parts; used is the one the offset_rule state selects.

total_delta_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

base_eve_clp.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

base_eve_ur.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15EveMeasure.description: Annex 1 delta EVE: the maximum over the six shocks of the pair total (there is no other currency in this book).

items.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

cash_flows.description: Net repricing cash flows of the buckets with t_k < 1, in the reporting currency.

items.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

delta_nii.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15NiiLeg.description: One leg under one parallel shock: delta NII = sum over the first six buckets of CF x (r0 - ri) x (1 - t_k).

max_pair.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

indexation_charge.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_nii.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15NiiMeasure.description: Annex 1 delta NII = the maximum over the two parallel shocks of the pair, plus the indexation charge.

delta_with_floor.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_without_floor.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

effect.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15FloorEffect.description: The effect of a binding post-shock floor on a leg's measure: with minus without.

c15FloorDistance.description: The lowest post-shock rate of a leg under one shock (over the 19 bucket midpoints for the delta EVE, the first six for the delta NII), the bucket where it is, the floor of the leg and the distance between them in basis points (lowest_rate minus floor, times 10 000); binds is true exactly when the distance is at most zero. The rates are those of the engine's shocked curves before the floor is applied.

distances.description: One row per leg (CLP then UR) and per shock the floors apply to: the six delta EVE shocks in the order of SHOCKS, then parallel-up and parallel-down for the delta NII. effects is non-empty exactly when a row binds.

c15Floors.description: Annex 1 post-shock floors: -2 percent for UR rates, 0 percent for other currencies (or the pre-shock rate if lower), where each leg stands against them (distances) and the effect of every floor that binds (effects).

c15Offset.description: The state of the CLP and CLF offset rule: on, off, or compared (both are in every pair; the rule applies in used).

pn_ur.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

abs_pn_ur.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

charge.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15Indexation.description: The standardised indexation (reajustabilidad) charge: 2.5 percent of the absolute net UF position PN_UR (an implied 2.5 percent inflation surprise). pn_ur = net UF position x uf_value, assets positive.

effect.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

anyOf.description: A CPI surprise applied to the net UF position, loss-positive: effect = -pn_ur x surprise_pp / 100.

c15CpiScenario.description: Null when the variant applies no CPI surprise.

measure.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

base.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15ThresholdTest.description: One prioritised-bank test of Annex 1: delta NII over Tier 1 (5 percent), delta EVE over Tier 1 (15 percent), delta NII over the 12-month net interest and indexation margin (18 percent).

tier1.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

net_interest_and_indexation_margin_12m.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15Thresholds.description: The banco priorizado tests; prioritised is true when any test is breached.

c15DynamicLeg.description: The dynamic NII of one leg; balances and NII are in the reporting currency (the UR leg converted at the UF value).

nii_quantile.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

eve_quantile.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

ear.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

evar.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

ear_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of ear, money (engine ear_evar_mc_error).

evar_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of evar, money (engine ear_evar_mc_error).

c15EarEvarLevel.description: EaR and EVaR at one confidence level: ear = base NII minus the (1 - level) quantile of the NII paths, evar likewise for EVE (loss-positive; engine ear_evar).

base_nii.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

base_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c15EarEvar.description: Ladder rung 6 (dossier 05 D.5 and D.6) for one leg: the distribution summary of the leg's NII and EVE under Hull-White one-factor or dynamic Nelson-Siegel scenario Monte Carlo, in the reporting currency (the UR leg converted at the UF value), with the number of paths, the seed and, at each level, the Monte Carlo standard error of EaR and EVaR by batch means over n_batches contiguous batches. base_nii is the base total of the leg's dynamic NII and base_eve the leg's base EVE.

c15DynamicNii.description: Ladder rung 5 for the CLP and UR legs (dossier 05 D.6). The EaR and EVaR of each leg are in ear_evar.

reporting_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

legs.description: The CLP leg and the UR leg, in that order.

ear_evar.description: The EaR and EVaR of the CLP leg and the UR leg, in that order.

c15Outputs.description: C15 annex1-variant outputs (outputs.kind annex1-variant): IRRBB on a CLP and UF balance sheet under RAN 21-13 Annex 1 for one SDD variant, balance sheet and curves as of one stated month. Money is in the reporting currency CLP; the UR leg is converted at the stated UF value.
